1,529 NEW UNITS APPROVED

Austin’s latest HOME Phase 1 update provides a fresh look at how the housing rules are being used.

City data updated November 4 reports:
• 954 applications reviewed
• 767 applications approved
• 1,529 new units approved
• 9 uses of the preservation bonus

These figures cover residential new-construction applications reviewed under HOME Phase 1. They are not a count of completed homes, occupied units or the entire city’s housing pipeline.

Phase 1 allows up to three homes on properties zoned SF-1, SF-2 and SF-3, subject to applicable requirements. It also revised rules for two-home properties and removed limits on unrelated adults sharing a housing unit.

For Austin owners, buyers and neighbors, the useful distinction is between what zoning allows, what the City approves and what ultimately gets built. This update measures the application and approval stage.

The numbers also should not be read as proof of a particular rent or sale-price outcome. They show activity under one specific housing policy.

Source: City of Austin Development Services, HOME Amendments; data updated November 4, 2026.
